title: C482/1649/2022 of SUNIL KUMAR RAI ALIAS SUNIL KUMAR YADAV Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports,
orders or proceedings or
directions and Registrar's
order with Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
15.09.2022 C-482 No. 1649 of 2022
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. D.S. Mehta, Advocate for
the applicants.
Mr. T.C. Aggarwal, learned
Deputy Advocate General for the State
of Uttarakhand.
Mr. N.K. Papnoi, Advocate for
complainant/respondent no. 2.
In the present C-482
application, the applicants, have put a
challenge to the Charge-Sheet No. 28 of
2019, dated 02.07.2019, in which.
after taking of cognizance they have
been summoned upon by the Court of
learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Champawat, vide its order dated
06.07.2019, for being tried in Criminal
Case No. 635 of 2019 "State Vs. Sunil
Kumar Rai and others", for their
alleged involvement in commission of
offence under Section 420 of I.P.C.
The present C-482 application
is accompanied with a compounding
application, which has been preferred

by the applicants, which has been duly
signed by the parties and their
counsels, whose signature has been
identified by their respective counsels,
who are appearing on their behalf.
Though, the applicants and
complainant-respondent no.2, are not
physically present in the Court, but the
statements made by the counsel at
Bar, and in the counter affidavit, and
the signatures, which has been placed
in the compounding application, since
has been verified by their counsels, the
Court thinks that their statements
would itself suffice in terms of the
conditions provided in their
vakalatnama, to be accepted by this
Court, for the purposes of composition
of the offences, which are exclusively
personal in nature, and would be
compoundable, with the leave of the
Court under Sub-Section (2) of Section
320 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
In that eventuality, while
considering the compounding
application, and the grounds of
settlement, which has been arrived at,

between the parties, which is
acceptable by the respective counsels
representing there cause, the C-482
application, would hereby stands
allowed, and as a consequence thereto,
the proceedings of the Criminal Case
No. 635 of 2019, "State Vs. Sunil
Kumar Rai and others", which is being
to be tried by the court of Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Champawat, for
the offence under Section 420 of I.P.C.,
would stand quashed, in terms of the
settlement referred, to in the
compounding application.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 15.09.2022
Mamta
